spans.s:
mfn. (-नुः-न्वी-नु)
Deformed.
m. (-नुः)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
कु bad, vile, and तनु body, this deity being of a monstrous appearance, having three legs and but eight teeth.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Slightly hot, mild, tepid.
mn. (-पः-पं)
1 The eighth Muhūrta or portion of the day, from the last Daṇḍa of the second watch to the first of the third or about noon; an eligible time for the performance of sacrifices to the manes.
2 A daughter's son.
3 A musical instrument.
4 A sort of blanket made of the hair of the mountain goat.
5 Sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.)
m. (-पः)
1 The sun.
2

Fire.
3

A twice born man, one of the three first classes.
4 A guest.
5 A sister's son.
6 An ox.
E.
कु the earth, and तप what warms, or कु diminutive, and तप heat; the sun being on the decline, &c.

n. (-कं)
A Śrāddha in which seven constituents occur, noon, a horn platter, a Nepal blanket, silver, sacrificial grass, sesamum and kine.
E.
कुतप, and सप्तक sevenfold.

ind.
Anywhere, somewhere.
E.
चन added to कुतस्.

ind.
Somewhere or other.
E.
चित् added to कुतस्.

ind.
Implying interrogation,
1 How, what.
2 How, in what way, how should it be thus, &c. implying denial or concealment of knowledge.
3 Whence, from what place.
E.
कु for किम् what, and तसिल् aff.

mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं)
Whence come, how happened.
E.
त्यप् added to the last.

n. (-कं)
1 Eagerness, vehemence.
2 Desire, inclination.
3 Curiosity.
E.
कुत a particular sound, कै to emit sound, ड affix; also कौतुक.

m. (-पः)
A small leathern oil bottle.
mn. (-पः-पं)
The eighth hour of the day: see कुतप.
E.
कुतू as below, and उपच् aff.

f. (-तूः)
A leathern oil bottle.
E.
कु bad, and तन to spread, डु affix, and the final lengthened.

m. (-कः)
Weakness of the eyes in infants; also read कुकूणक.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Excellent, best, praised, celebrated.
3 Surprising, wonderful.
n. (-लं)
Eagerness, vehemence, impetuosity.
2 Desire, inclination.
3 Curiosity.
E.
कु bad, तूल to send forth, क affix, and ह inserted; or कुतू an oil bottle, and हल to make lines or furrows; or कु the earth, and तुद to vex or tease; the etymologies however are all fanciful; the word is also written कौतूहल.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
1 Curious, inquisitive.
2 Eager, impatient.
E.
कुतूहल, and इनि aff.

n. (-णं)
An aquatic plant, water house-leek, (Pistia stratiotes.)
E.
कु bad, तृण grass.

ind.
Where, wherein, in what place.
E.
कु substituted for किं what, and त्रल् aff.

ind.
Somewhere.
E.
चित् added to कुत्र.

ind.
Wherever, somewhere.
E.
कुत्र, and अपि certainly.

r. 10th cl. (कुत्सयते-ति)
To despise, to abuse, to revile.

f. (-त्सा)
Reproach, contempt, censure.
E.
कुत्स to despise, अङ् and टाप् affs.

n. (-नं)
Abuse, contempt, reproach, reviling.
E.
कुत्स to revile, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-ला)
The indigo plant: see नीली.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Censorious, abusive.
E.
कुत्स, and वादिन् who speaks.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Low, vile, contemptible, contemned, reviled, &c.
n. (-तं)
A grass, (Cyperus.)
E.
कुत्स to reproach, &c., and क्त aff.
